title: Uniqueness of the global orientation
statement:
In the purity conventions of this chapter ([def-pur-conventions] fixed setting), let $Y$ and $\kappa(t)$ be as in
[thm-pur-affine-line-orientation]. The restriction of the
homomorphism group to
geometric points is an
injective map

$$
\operatorname{Hom}_{D(Y,\Lambda)}
\bigl(\Lambda_Y,Rs^!\Lambda_{\mathbf A^1_Y}(1)[2]\bigr)
\longrightarrow
\prod_{\bar y\to Y}H^2_{s(\bar y)}(\mathbf A^1_{\bar y},\Lambda(1)),
$$

whose image contains the family with every component $1\in\Lambda$ (by
[thm-pur-rank-one-local-calculation] and the normalization of
[thm-pur-affine-line-orientation]). Consequently
$\operatorname{pur}_s$ is the unique global morphism whose pullback to
every geometric point is the normalized class $1$.

proof.text: Take the support chart, global orientation, fibre charts, transports and normalized residues supplied by thm-pur-affine-line-orientation. Assemble them as OrientationRestrictionData. The residue isomorphism sends both the restricted global orientation and the inverse image of 1 to 1, hence injectivity of the residue gives equality of these fibre classes. Function extensionality gives equality with the normalized family.

Apply lem-pur-affine-line-orientation-injectivity to the chosen chart and transports. Equality in the geometric family is equality at each geometric point, so the restriction map is injective. The global orientation constructed above is in its image. Applying injectivity to equality with this normalized family proves uniqueness. The supported-stalk lemma below the injectivity theorem carries the supported-Hom and geometric comparison steps; the current proof does not reprove those steps in this module.

split_report.summary: Expanded the imported paragraph into six steps. Derived that the actual Kummer orientation trivializes the degree-zero support sheaf by the unit localization argument, computed the restriction of every morphism as the germ of its scalar section, and proved section detection on etale models rather than on arbitrary pro-etale sheaves. Checked the conditional normalized-datum Lean declarations and did not attach them, since they do not discharge the concrete normalization used here. No statement changes or new nodes. Repair after landing refusal: re-read the revised def-pur-conventions and all direct cited statements on the current DAG; made the finite coefficient unit and constructible exceptional-functor convention explicit in step 1 and identified the closed etale adjoint with its finite-level transported value and counit in step 2. Added verbatim citations for these uses; the statement and unit route remain unchanged. Fresh second reading: made explicit the passage from finite direct-image exactness on abelian sheaves to module sheaves and termwise derived direct image; independently revalidated all six steps and all 45 citation quotes. Dedicated re-split repair by NX: extracted the transported localization triangle and its boundary-edge compatibility into lem-pur-retracted-support-localization-comparison. Replaced the inline finite closed-source base-change proof by the existing finite-exchange and exchange-naturality statements. Retained the original statement and steps 1, 3, 5, 6. Normalization and injectivity are still proved in the item. Maintainer review fix (NX, 2026-10-17): step 2 now obtains the etale model of A_X(1) on X from twist constructibility and constructible etale origin (the affine-line datum only constructs one on U); step 4 now derives r_y(phi)=a_y r_y(pur_s) from naturality of supported-Hom and of the supported pullback in the coefficient, using that s_*m_a is multiplication by the global section p^{-1}a, instead of an unstated compatibility of the Hom form with pullback; the finite-exchange citations are therefore dropped.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NX-5d02a69a6 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole delivery: the item, the new lemma, every cited statement (with its blueprint_update), the main-20261015 sk-prop-a1 unit and the item proof, and the duplicate candidates. The new lemma is true. Its triangle is the etale closed-support triangle pushed forward by Rp_et,* using ps=id and pj=pi, then carried over by nu^* and the qcqs comparison; C = nu^* s^x B because B is bounded below. Its edge identity is the naturality of the edge map applied to d. I tested s=id, Y empty, B=0 and shifted B. It does not restate a clause of the item and duplicates no node. lem-pur-support-localization-triangle is the closest candidate, and the report did not mention it (C5 gap): it gives only the pro-etale supported-sections Rs^!, conditionally identified with a right adjoint on all of D^+, which the transported functor is not. Three repairable faults, all fixed in fixes/: (B, form) the new node lacked merged_into and lean_audit; both are added. (C4) step 2 took the etale model of A_X(1) on X from def-pur-affine-line-datum, which constructs one only on U; it now uses lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free(4) and lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin(ii), both declared in tool_uses. (E5/C4) step 4 assumed, without any cited statement, that pulling back a supported class in the Hom form of lem-pur-supported-hom is h^* followed by the finite exchange. I rewrote it: s_*m_a is multiplication by the global section p^{-1}a, which commutes with every morphism, so naturality of supported-hom and of the support pullback in the coefficient gives r_y(phi)=a_y r_y(pur_s). The finite-exchange, exchange-naturality, finite-direct-image-exact, inverse-image-modules-exact and comparison-direct-image citations are therefore removed from the step, proof_deps and tool_uses. Steps 1, 3, 5 and 6 are correct as written; the statement is unchanged and nothing is weakened. No SGA source. I accept the remaining off-unit tool_uses as generic black boxes. Details are in review.md.; 2 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
